definitions.explanation: A doctor with an outstanding reputation for diagnosis and treatment. The word carries admiration and is used of individuals people seek out by name, often by word of mouth.

examples.japanese: {名医|めいい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He is known as a renowned doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名医|めいい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{診|み}て→診る：09798_miru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had a much-talked-about specialist examine me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名医|めいい}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いている→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I hear he is such a renowned doctor that patients come to him from all over the country.

notes:
The prefix {名|めい} means "famous, master-class" and forms a productive set of praise words: {名医|めいい}, ⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧ (master), ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧ (masterpiece), {名選手|めいせんしゅ} (star player).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名医|めいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a good doctor
- ⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名医|めいい}: a doctor with a great reputation
- {名医|めいい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巡|めぐ}り{会|あ}う: to be lucky enough to find a great doctor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {専門医|せんもんい}: specialist — a factual qualification, not praise
- ⟦{主治医|しゅじい}→主治医：11465_shujii⟧: attending physician — the doctor in charge of your case
- やぶ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧: quack — the opposite, a doctor considered incompetent
